band_by_marginal_strength.note: strata are deciles of log2(RR_a * RR_b); the reference band is `unsupported`, matching the pooled band table

event_definition.note: core is the primary analysis; broad is sensitivity only and is inclusive of core

fdr.method: Benjamini-Hochberg on one-sided Poisson tail probabilities
fdr.note: the shrinkage bound is not a p-value and carries no multiplicity guarantee; this is the FDR-controlled count for comparison

heldout_calibration.note: in-sample calibration returns the target by construction; the held-out rate is the measured one

induced_correlation.note: x = log2(RR_a * RR_b). Omega = log2((O+a)/(E+a)); E rises with x by construction, so a negative r is partly mechanical. The null simulation draws O from each model's own expectation.

inpatient_stratification.note: stratified on FAERS outc_cod = 'HO', the reported hospitalisation outcome, rather than a 30-drug proxy

nesting_condition.note: the multiplicative signal set nests inside the additive one when both marginals are elevated; the unconditional form stated in the literature fails otherwise

null_nesting.note: both nulls are log2((n+a)/(E+a)) under identical shrinkage, so E_mult >= E_add implies the multiplicative signal set is contained in the additive one; the antecedent holds almost always in the drug-dominant regime and rarely outside it

polypharmacy_bands.note: a case with k drugs contributes k(k-1)/2 pairs; the aggregate enrichment above the cap hides a reversal in the largest band

provenance.note: pipeline figures quoted in the papers, persisted so the availability claim is true rather than assumed

reference_coverage.note: restricted to non-control pairs where BOTH drugs have an FDA label, so 'undocumented' means the label is silent, not absent

top_ranked_pairs.note: signalled pairs with at least 50 co-reports, ranked by event rate; the third-drug share is the proxy test of 4.7, where a known proxy scores near 100%

vocabulary_hygiene.note: the screened set is chosen mechanically by co-reporting; these terms are reported as a sensitivity, not removed from the primary analysis

era_stability_validation.note: the era-stability filter applied to the negative controls; omitted from the first version of this analysis

anaphylaxis.design_note: co-exposures among independently anaphylactogenic agents, not interaction pairs; cannot test the conditional claim at any sample size
anaphylaxis.expected: drug-caused but marginals diffuse across many agents
anaphylaxis.label: anaphylaxis

torsade_qt_broad_pts.label: torsade/QT, broad PT list (non-specific terms retained)

independent_annotation.note: pairs containing no positive-control drug; removes the circularity in the support annotation

label_reference.note: FDA product labelling via openFDA; independent of the authors' curation but not of FAERS

positive_control_verification.note: each control checked against the cached FDA label text; citation_status in config/positive_controls.csv was 'to_verify' for all 16 and had never been checked

high_marginal_pool.note: pairs whose two drugs are each associated with the event (RR >= 2.0) but which are not documented interactions; excludes both-implicated pairs as too likely to be undocumented true positives

in_regime.note: the negative pool spans a far weaker range than the positive controls; a pooled false-positive rate is not the rate in the regime where recovery is measured

matched_recovery.caveat: calibrating a tail quantile on this many negatives is noisy; the 5%/10%/20% points rest on roughly 5%/10%/20% of them

operating_characteristic.note: recovery against in-regime false-positive rate for both nulls, swept over the same regime-matched negative pool

strength_matched_chance.note: the pooled rate assumes the false-positive rate is constant across the marginal-strength range; it varies by an order of magnitude, and the bands differ systematically on it

third_estimand.note: a third estimand anchored on each drug's own partner distribution, evaluated against both published nulls on IDENTICAL pairs -- those appearing in the screen

in_regime.note: the negative pool spans a far weaker range than the positive controls; a pooled false-positive rate is not the rate in the regime where recovery is measured

matched_recovery.caveat: calibrating a tail quantile on this many negatives is noisy; the 5%/10%/20% points rest on roughly 5%/10%/20% of them

drug_selection.note: selection by event co-reporting is selection on the dependent variable; selection by total volume is not

independent_positive_controls.note: label-documented myotoxicity pairs excluding the 16 author-chosen controls; selected by FDA labelling, not by the authors. Both nulls reported at both thresholds -- Tier A uses 0, the screen uses the calibrated threshold.

ingredient_accuracy.note: upper bound on level-2 backfill accuracy; FDA's own annotation of one verbatim string is this consistent

pt_second_annotation.note: mechanical second annotation, not a second human reader

residual_near_duplicates.note: event cases with a populated event date and age; blocked on event date, age, sex and country

specification_grid.note: all four tier x role-policy arms; core/primary is pre-specified in config as event.primary_tier
